decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Any plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises. The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not exceed the existing background sound level (LA90,15mins) when measured (LAeq,15mins) 1 metre external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6bee96e9-7fff-0192-5b1e-406874403ed1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Reason: To protect acceptable local noise levels</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The use hereby permitted, or the operation of any building services plant, shall not commence until a post-installation noise assessment has been carried out to confirm compliance with the noise criteria - Condition 3. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details, and they shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order for the duration of the use and their operation.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-cf776a67-7fff-6157-a38d-2095a5177125"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area. </span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved:</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">23548 001 P2 (Dated 19/02/2026); 23548 002 P1 (Dated 19/02/2026); 23548 003 P1 (Dated 19/02/2026); 23548 004 P3 (Dated 14/05/2026)</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e24f65e3-7fff-afd2-77e8-7c4ad86a93fb"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</span></p>
description: Variation of Condition 1 (approved drawings) and removal of Conditions 2 and 3 (acoustic mitigation) attached to planning permission ref 2025/2581 dated 20/02/2026 for the retrospective application for the installation of two air conditioning condenser units on rear single-storey flat roof and the erection of associated screening. The variation would involve the relocation of the compressor components internally and remove the requirement to install post-installation acoustic mitigation.
